title.narrative: Provision of integrated life-saving and life-sustaining seasonal assistance to the most vulnerable population in underserved areas

description.narrative: ltpgtAccording to 2024 Syria Humanitarian Needs Overview (HNO), approximately 10 million people are in need of sufficient and appropriate winter clothing, as well as safe and adequate heating devices to maintain a dignified living space. This, coupled with the deterioration of shelter integrity and increasing shelter adequacy issues (limited electricity/lighting and poor insulation from heat/cold), exposes households to harsh weather conditions with a high risk of loss of life, particularly during winter.ltbrgtThrough this project, UNHCR intends to provide lifesaving and life-sustaining winter non-food assistance to the most vulnerable internally displaced and returnee families as well as host communities in underserved areas in Ar-Raqqa and Deir-Ez-Zor Governorates.ltbrgtThe targeted areas are included in the list of priority sub-districts (Annex 2 of the SHF Allocation Strategy). ltbrgtWithin the proposed project, UNHCR is planning to provide 5,598 winterization kits (2,799 in Ar-Raqqa and 2,799 in Deir-Ez-Zor Governorates), benefitting 5,598 families (27,990 people) in these two locations. The standard winterization kit for a family of five includes five high thermal blankets, two winter jackets, one winter clothing kit, one plastic sheet and one carpet.ltbrgtTo ensure timely distribution of winter NFI kits and avoid any delays, UNHCR will release the items from its existing emergency stocks for the distribution in parallel with procurement of items for replenishment. Needed items are available in stock.ltbrgtUNHCR will utilize the fund requested under this project only to cover the procurement of winterization kits to replenish the distributed items. Other project costs including financial transfers to sub implementing partners for distributions etc. will be covered through other resources and will not be charged to the SHF funding.ltbrgtlt/pgt
